summary: Design and scale a continuous learning culture with strategy, analytics, and governance. Enroll your leaders and L&D teams today.
lede: Continuous learning culture training helps learning, talent, and HR professionals make development part of everyday work. For people who shape learning or culture across teams, it covers diagnosing learning maturity, mapping role capabilities into pathways, and equipping managers to support learning through coaching and performance conversations. Participants also design learning workflows and dashboards that connect culture measures with performance and retention outcomes.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is for you if you already influence learning, talent, or culture decisions and now need to design and scale a continuous learning environment across functions and levels.
audience: Chief Learning Officer / Head of Learning
People Analytics or Learning Analytics Specialist
modules: Measurement, Learning Analytics, and Culture KPIs
Designing a Continuous Learning Culture Blueprint
Manager and Leader Enablement for Learning
Systems, Processes, and Learning-in-the-Flow of Work
Change Management and Adoption for Learning Culture
prerequisites: This advanced course assumes you already play a role in learning, talent, HR, or transformation and want to move from running programs to architecting a continuous learning culture across the organization.
